g.text: Logical view - code (C4 level 4): slot generation, «free» and a slot's price
Consecutive slots of exact duration from opening,
measured in real time between UTC instants:
for (start = opensAt; start + length ≤ closesAt; start += length).
25 h on 2026-10-25 and 23 h on 2026-03-29 in Lisbon.
A time that does not exist (clocks forward): moves forward past the gap
(01:30 → 02:30 WEST). A repeated time (clocks back): the first
half-open overlap with a block or a
